transport: Existing authenticated canonical gateway connection, already subscribed to the original session. Profile is connection-scoped; no profile redirect parameter.
bindResult: Baseline bindingFields. Host-only approve verifies native transport and explicit user gesture, captures Origin, and creates a one-use ticket tied to that actual connection for at most 60 seconds. No approve/submit RPC or model/tool gesture proof.
inspectResult: Baseline inspectFields; unknown has schemaVersion/status/retryAuthorized=false only. Known events additionally carry immutable descriptor, deliveryAuthorized and optional canonical receipt/result. Inspect is never resend authority.

liveAndReplay.background_v1: Exact baseline descriptorFields; marker lifecycle_update. Canonical authority/generation/admission ID and replay epoch/sequence stay on the ordinary event frame.

promptReceipt.result: Existing canonical result.final_response; never plugin text
promptReceipt.earlySettlement: A receipt still exposing started during publication cannot authorize delivery.

effects.operation: Consumer-generated durable exact-operation ID, persisted before begin
effects.client: Host derives from authenticated subject AND transport ID; forbidden in RPC input
effects.finishResult: Baseline revocation status; finish only after physical stop/relinquishment by the exact authenticated transport owner
effects.disconnect: A new transport cannot finish old custody. Remains revoking/effectsStopped=false. No timeout, same-subject takeover or automatic reconnect recovery.

producerPython.accessor: ctx.background_v1, host-exposed only to exact profile/plugin manager; None otherwise
producerPython.prepare: prepare(bindingId,event) -> {event:frozenCanonicalEvent,digest}; persist both with original binding before first attempt; not an admission
producerPython.submit: await submit(bindingId,prepared.event) -> baseline inspect result; commit/publication/schedule use existing tracked ordered writes
producerPython.inspect: inspect(bindingId,eventId,prepared.digest) -> baseline inspect result after any uncertain ACK; no resend on unknown
producerPython.authority: No actor, arbitrary destination, epoch, descriptor, client or private authority passed by plugin.

hostComposition: Complete pinned pre/postimage verification and loaded canonical code match
Host loader registers verified producer version and incarnation; immutable incarnation-to-version mapping, at most 20 retained
Host exposes facade to exact profile/plugin manager; unregister removes only its exact facade
No capability advertisement until consumer/native/application qualification is reviewed
disable: Host.detach durably revokes grants/registration and cancels only their exact queued admissions; preserves all identities and outstanding effect custody. Does not certify physical stop or remove source bytes.
consumerDecisionRequired: Accept exact new method/field names and existing closed descriptor on both live/replay and prompt.receipt
Wire genuine native consent gesture and transport attestation, not JSON flags or legacy owner registration alone
Accept fail-closed transport-bound custody after disconnect, or separately design/review authenticated custody recovery before activation
Independently validate v1 provenance and canonical fences in Rust before persistence/render/speech; use begin/finish on actual side effects
